title: Resilient sharpness function
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $k<n-1$, the function constructed from the first $k+1$ coordinates and the remaining coordinates as in the resilient sharpness construction is $k$-resilient: its nonempty Fourier coefficients on sets of at most $k$ coordinates vanish, and its mean is zero.
